faqs.title: How do I play Hexa Sort?
faqs.body:
• In order to complete a level, you need to place tiles to sort and merge them
  • You have to place similar colored hex tiles next to each other on the board to sort and stack them.
  • Once you have 10 tiles in a stack the stack will merge and pop
  • Each level gives you a new goal to achieve.
  • You must collect the given number of hex tiles to pass the level.
  • Place the same-colored tiles together and watch them stack, sort, and merge satisfyingly. The collected tiles will allow you to color & build a beautiful world after completing each level.

faqs.title: How do the stacks/tiles merge?
faqs.body:
• Once you place a similar colored stack next to each other, the new stack placed by the user will pull the tiles of the similar colored tiles from the previously placed stack.
  • You need to place at least 10 tiles in a stack for it to merge.
  • Even in a 3-chain (bridge) scenario, suppose you have 2 red stacks with an empty slot between them, and you put another red hex stack in that slot, the last placed hex tile on the board will pull the tiles from the stack that is already placed.

Play On: Use coins to remove four stacks and continue playing. 

You can also restart the level by using lives.

faqs.title: Winner's Wheel and Super Winner's Wheel
faqs.body:
Complete levels to unlock the Spin Wheel for rewards!

Tap on the icon to view the Winner’s Wheel - here you can see the available rewards, as well as the amount of levels to complete. Once you’ve done this, you’ll unlock a free spin! Your reward is added to your account immediately.

Using the free spin on the Winner’s Wheel will also unlock the Super Winner’s Wheel Offer - this is a separate Spin Wheel that has higher rewards available.

 

Please note that unlocking the Super Winner’s Wheel will not provide a free spin. To be able to spin the Super Winner’s Wheel, you will have to tap on the button and make an in-app purchase.

faqs.title: Leaderboard
faqs.body:
What is the Leaderboard

  • A leaderboard is a rank system in Hexa Sort, allowing players to compete against each other.
  • Rise through the ranks and win prizes.
  • The Leaderboard is unlocked after you clear level 5.
  • There are two types of Leaderboards:
    • Leagues
    • Global

What are the Leagues

League is a type of timed event that resets every week, from the day that you download and start playing the game.

 

How do Leagues work 

  • Leagues all have a seven-day timer meaning you not only have to play to reach the top but also you have to fight to maintain your position and earn podium prizes!
  • There is a total of 6 Leagues that you can compete in:
    • Bronze
    • Mercury League
    • Golden League
    • Scarlet League
    • Sapphire League
    • Diamond
  • At each level that you clear, you can earn trophies to increase your position in the league leaderboard.
  • There are 3 Zones in the Leaderboard:
    • Promotion Zone will let you be promoted to the next league with a league promotion reward.
    • Persisting Zone will keep you in the same league with no reward.
    • Demotion Zone will demote you to the previous league.
  • Your final rank for a league will be recorded when the league ends
  • The top 3 players on the leaderboard will earn an extra prize!

Global Leaderboard

The Global Leaderboard lets you see how you rank against other players in your country and around the world.

To move up the leaderboard and become a Hall of Famer, clear as many levels as you can within 3 months. Both the global and country leaderboards reset every 3 months.

You can participate in the Global Leaderboard on the 1st of July!

Global

  • Compete with the top 1,000 players worldwide.
  • Gain points by clearing levels to rise through the ranks.

Local

  • Compete with the top 1,000 players in your country.
  • Clear levels to improve your ranking.

Hall of Fame

  • The Hall of Fame displays the top three players globally from the previous quarter.
  • Clear as many levels as possible within 3 months to earn a spot in the Hall of Fame.

What is the Battle Pass Event?

  • The Battle Pass event is a unique timed event that refreshes every month.
  • Every month there is a new theme, The current theme is Aerial Odyssey
  • The battle pass is unlocked after level 15

How does the Battle Pass Event work?

    • You automatically join a battle pass event once it starts
    • There are two tiers to each battle pass with rewards on completing a certain number of levels
    • The battle pass can be accessed through the main menu once it is unlocked
    • Press on activate to purchase your premium battle pass.
    • Once your premium tier is finished you can unlock your chest for the ultimate coin prize!
    • If you purchase the battle pass on the 28th, the battle pass will only be valid for 2 days, and so on.
    • Even with a free battle pass you can progress through the stages and unlock your premium prizes later by purchasing the Gold or the Ultimate pass!

faqs.body:

    • Use the Restore Purchases Button found in the settings menu
    • If the Restore Purchases Button doesn't fix the issue, please delete the game from your device settings and reinstall it.
    • In case that does not work either, please contact in-game chat support with the purchase receipts (found in your email) mentioning:
      • Order Number
      • Date

faqs.title: Blaze streak
faqs.body:
What is the Hexa Blaze Streak?

  • Hexa Blaze Streak is a timed event that you can join any day of the week
  • The event is unlocked after you clear level 8
  • The Event is started from the moment you tap join
  • The event duration for Hexa Blaze Streak is 3 days i.e 72 hours after you press join

How does Hexa Blaze Streak work?

  • You have to complete levels without failing to maintain a streak.
  • Every time you lose a level you are demoted to the last tier
  • Each tier has a different requirement for how many levels you need to clear without failing
  • At the end of each tier, you can collect rewards, additionally, if you clear 100 levels without failing in 3 days you can collect the grand prize!

faqs.title: Lives
faqs.body:
What are Lives?

  • Lives show you the number of attempts you can have to complete a level
  • You lose one life (attempt) each time you fail a level
  • You can see how many lives you have from the heart-shaped icon displayed at the top middle of the home screen
  • You have a maximum of 5 lives available, which are increased to 8 if you buy the Ultimate Gold Pass
  • One life is refilled every 30 minutes

How can I get more lives?

  • You can purchase the Safety Net Offer that contains Infinite Lives allowing you to play as much as you like without worrying about the number of attempts.
  • You can get infinite lives for 30 minutes from the Daily Rewards
  • You can purchase the Ultimate Gold Pass that increases your lives to 8
  • Lives also regenerate automatically every 30 minutes.
